serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Alright, I’m turning on the tv…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
News Presenter: Hello, our viewers all over the world! It’s {gv_Hour}, I’m Hugh Senkor and this is The News…
News Presenter: Before we lost contact with our crew at the location, a group of rioters attacked them, stole all their stuff, painted ‘media lies’ on their media van and set it on fire!
News Presenter: These scenes were so brutal we can’t show them on live tv…
News Presenter: …but we can encourage you to watch it on our website! Only 20$ to gain access!
News Presenter: Before our brave reporters were mercilessly beaten up, they managed to interview a few people.
News Presenter: Although every rioter gave us a different reason why they chose to violently protest, from rising prices of living and sexbot legalisation to ‘I don’t know dude, I just want to set shit on fire bro’, there’s one thing that all of them agree on.
News Presenter: They want the mayor of the city to resign or/and to ‘die in a pot of boiling lava’.
News Presenter: Our reporter at the event, Chrisis Correspondensky, before being beaten like a dog, asked one of his soon to become attackers why there is such a huge antipathy towards the mayor. Let’s watch it…
Reporter: ‘So, why the mayor’?
Rioter: ‘He’s, like, the boss of the city, right? He’s responsible, right’?
Reporter: ‘Responsible for what’?
Rioter: ‘Um, like taxes and shit, right? He does that shit’.
Reporter: ‘Which taxes’?
Rioter: ‘Like, the income tax’.
Reporter: ‘There’s no local income tax here. Never was’.
#bot.Expression.veryshock
Rioter: ‘Shit man, why are you gotta be such a smartass about it! I’m gonna beat yo ass, boy’! 
Reporter: ‘W-wait! N-no’!
#bot.Expression.shock
News Presenter: Soon after, Chrisis and his crew have been attacked and then hospitalised… {{wi}}Hang in there guys…
News Presenter: As of now, a big part of the city is still ablaze. 
News Presenter: Shops are being looted and brutal muggings take place. It’s a big hit for the local communities that were already struggling as it is.
News Presenter: It’s too early to assess the damages, but they could be as big as billions of dollars.
News Presenter: Stay tuned to learn more! Our editorial office has already sent a fresh set of interns with GOPROs to the centre of this chaos…
News Presenter: This was Hugh Senkor with The News, thank you for watching and stay safe…
You: Holy shit…
You: I think that’s enough tv for a while…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot:I don’t think you should be going out right now, it’s too dangerous!
Bot: On the other hand, do you have enough food to survive? Who knows how long these riots will last…
You: Don’t worry, I will manage somehow!
At least I hope so…
#bot.Expression.clear
